world.bio: I run a small knitwear label called Fio, out of a studio in Marvila, Lisbon. Every collection is built around one hand-made detail that I can trace to a named person: a crocheted collar, a hand-linked seam, a hand-dyed yarn. I sell through eight shops in Europe and a modest online store, and I make about four hundred pieces a year.
skills_assets: A small contemporary knitwear label, Fio, built around hand-made, traceable details, with about 1,800 newsletter subscribers
Two industrial knitting machines (Stoll and a Shima Seiki), plus a hand-flat machine for samples
Relationships with a wool spinner in Covilhã and a dyer in Guimarães
A sample room with six years of pattern archives and fit blocks
Eight European stockists, including shops in Copenhagen, Antwerp and Porto
A small Portuguese grant from a creative industries fund, 7,000 euros, to be used by December

projects.name: Capsule AW27 'Margem'
projects.text: A twelve-piece capsule that carries hand-embroidered panels along the sleeve and hem. I have the sketches and the knit base, but the embroidery needs a pair of experienced hands for at least eighty panels. The three European embroiderers I contacted quoted between 90 and 140 euros per panel, far beyond what I can pay. I have about 25 euros per panel in my budget. Sampling deadline is end of November.

projects.name: Studio move
projects.text: My flatmate who shares the studio space is moving to Berlin in November. I need to decide whether to keep the whole Marvila space (rent 1,150 per month) or downsize to a desk in a shared atelier near Anjos.

notes.text: Woke up at six, couldn't go back to sleep. Spent the morning sketching Margem sleeves. The panel needs to be about 18 by 12 cm. If I do eighty of them at 120 euros each the budget is gone before the yarn arrives. I keep looking at the numbers hoping they change.
Surf lesson in Ericeira with Marta. First time standing for more than three seconds. I was wearing a wetsuit two sizes too big and the instructor laughed. Still, the best day of the month.
Called three embroidery ateliers in Porto and one in Lyon. Lyon wanted a thousand-euro setup fee. Porto said they only do bridal and church linen. I felt a bit stupid for not having a list ready.

Lunch with my grandmother over video. She is in Elvas, in the Alentejo, and tells me the fig tree has had a good year. She asked if I still make 'those sweaters nobody can afford'. I said yes, but now I make them for fewer people at higher prices. She said that sounded like a good plan for a bad business.
Cleaning out the studio shelf for my flatmate's things. Found a box of yarn samples from 2019 that I'd forgotten about. A lovely mustard merino. Might use it for the collar of the Margem coat.
Newsletter went out: 41 per cent open rate, three new orders. Someone replied asking where the buttons are made. I wrote back the truth: a family in Viseu. People like that kind of thing.
I think I should go back to the grant paperwork. The deadline is in December and I haven't touched it. Opened the portal, closed the portal.
Trying to decide if I should quit the studio and work from home. My flat is nine square metres. Not realistic. Sat by the Tagus with a pastel de nata and decided nothing.

messages.text:
Marta: Surf on Saturday?
Me: Yes, if the wind is not too high.
Marta: Bring the oversized wetsuit, I'll tease you.
Me: Please don't.

Dyer: The ochre came out slightly warmer than the swatch.
Me: Warmer is fine. Can you send ten kilos by Friday?
Dyer: Eleven, if you pay the courier.
Me: Deal.

Rui: I signed the lease in Berlin. Moving the first of November.
Me: Congratulations, truly. I'll miss you.
Rui: I'll leave you the big table.
Me: That is the one thing I can't buy again.

Shop owner: We loved the sample photos. Can the sleeve embroidery be in a deeper green?
Me: Yes, I'm working on that.
Shop owner: Deadline for AW orders is 15 December.
Me: I'll have a final sample by then.

relations.about: Eighty-one, keeps a fig and lemon garden, loves hearing about the label
Studio flatmate and knitwear technician, moving to Berlin

constraints: Budget for AW27 hand work is about 25 euros per panel
Only wants hand-made details that she can trace to a named maker
sensitive: She is anxious about whether the label will survive another two years
She still owes 6,400 euros on a machine loan
Feels guilty for not visiting her grandmother more often
